family_reports.body: The family court has stolen time with my kids memories I can never get…
On false allegations with no evidence, I was reduced from full physical and legal…
I now have two emotionally damaged children and have been barred from helping them.…

The next hearing he almost completely removed all visitation rights of the father based on a nickname that the father had used with the minor all her life. This was contested an open court, and the hearing that was supposedly scheduled…
